responsibility: This header declares the mc-boot runtime interface to the host math library. It publishes wrappers for standard transcendental and rounding operations across double, long double, and float variants, including sin/cos/tan, sqrt, asin/acos/atan, atan2, exp, log, pow, floor, ceil, and exp10 families, providing the stable libm bridge used by generated Modula-2 code and numeric runtime helpers.
